# sqlpipe

sqlpipe is a command-line tool that syncs PostgreSQL tables to Amazon S3 as Parquet files. It connects directly to your database, reads table data in configurable batches, and writes compressed Parquet files to a specified S3 prefix. Incremental syncs are supported out of the box — point sqlpipe at a timestamp or serial column, and it picks up where the last run left off.

Designed for data engineers who need a lightweight, dependency-free way to land database tables into a lake or warehouse staging area, sqlpipe handles schema mapping from Postgres types to Parquet, manages multipart uploads for large tables, and runs as a single static binary with no runtime dependencies beyond valid AWS credentials.
